services.plainBody:
Tax Due Diligence is an essential part of mergers, acquisitions, investments, business restructuring, and strategic transactions. It helps identify potential tax risks, compliance gaps, pending litigations, and hidden liabilities before a transaction is completed. Conducting a thorough tax review enables buyers, investors, and businesses to make informed decisions while reducing future tax exposure.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we perform comprehensive tax due diligence by reviewing historical tax records, compliance status, and ongoing tax matters to provide clients with a clear understanding of potential risks and opportunities.

Our Tax Due Diligence Services

Comprehensive Review of Income Tax Returns & Assessments

We examine historical tax records to evaluate the overall tax position of the business.

Our review includes:

Income Tax Returns filed over previous years.

Assessment orders and scrutiny proceedings.

Outstanding tax demands.

Pending tax disputes and appeals.

Identification of Tax Contingent Liabilities

Potential tax liabilities may significantly impact the value of a transaction if not identified in advance.

We assist in:

Identifying contingent tax liabilities.

Reviewing pending penalty proceedings.

Evaluating ongoing tax litigation.

Assessing potential future tax exposures.

Review of TDS, Advance Tax & Compliance Records

Compliance history provides valuable insight into the tax health of an organisation.

Our review includes:

TDS compliance.

Advance tax payments.

Statutory filing history.

Tax payment reconciliations.

Analysis of Tax Positions & Aggressive Claims

Certain deductions, exemptions, or tax positions may increase the likelihood of future scrutiny.

We evaluate:

Tax deductions claimed.

Exemptions and incentives availed.

Significant tax positions adopted.

Potential compliance risks.

Transaction Risk Assessment Report

After completing the review, we prepare a detailed due diligence report highlighting identified risks and recommended corrective measures.

The report includes:

Risk categorisation.

Compliance observations.

Potential financial exposure.

Recommendations for risk mitigation.

Benefits of Tax Due Diligence

Identification of hidden tax liabilities.

Better decision-making during transactions.

Reduced post-acquisition tax risks.

Improved tax compliance.

Enhanced investor confidence.

Structured risk assessment.

Step

Our Approach

Examine tax records, returns, and financial information.

Risk Assessment

Prepare a detailed report with findings and recommendations.

Advisory Support

Assist clients in addressing identified risks before transaction completion.

services.title: TDS on Non-resident Payments

Determining the correct tax deduction requires careful analysis of the nature of the payment, residential status of the recipient, treaty benefits, and regulatory requirements. Incorrect withholding may result in interest, penalties, and disallowance of expenses.

services.plainBody:
Succession and estate planning play a vital role in protecting family wealth, ensuring business continuity, and facilitating the smooth transfer of assets across generations. A well-structured estate plan minimizes uncertainty, reduces the likelihood of family disputes, and provides clarity regarding the ownership and management of assets after succession.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we help individuals, business owners, and families develop customized succession strategies that align with their financial objectives while considering the tax implications of asset transfers and business succession.

Our Succession & Estate Planning Services

Comprehensive Asset Mapping & Wealth Structuring

An effective estate plan begins with a clear understanding of the family's assets and financial interests.

Our services include:

Identification of movable and immovable assets.

Review of financial investments.

Business interest evaluation.

Wealth structuring advisory.

Will Structuring & Legal Coordination

A properly drafted Will helps ensure that assets are distributed according to the individual's wishes.

We assist with:

Will planning advisory.

Coordination with legal professionals.

Review of estate distribution plans.

Documentation support.

Business Succession & Control Transition Planning

Family businesses require structured succession planning to ensure continuity and stability.

Our advisory includes:

Leadership transition planning.

Shareholding restructuring.

Ownership transition strategies.

Governance advisory.

Capital Gains & Transfer Tax Impact Analysis

Asset transfers may have tax implications that should be evaluated before implementation.

We assist with:

Capital gains analysis.

Transfer tax planning.

Asset restructuring advisory.

Tax-efficient succession strategies.

Family Settlement Structuring

Well-planned family settlements can help prevent future disputes and facilitate smooth wealth distribution.

Our services include:

Family settlement planning.

Asset distribution advisory.

Documentation support.

Tax implication analysis.

Intergenerational Wealth Preservation Strategy

Long-term planning helps protect family wealth and ensure financial stability for future generations.

Our advisory focuses on:

Wealth preservation strategies.

Long-term asset planning.

Family governance support.

Multi-generational financial planning.

Benefits of Succession & Estate Planning

Smooth transfer of family wealth.

Reduced risk of inheritance disputes.

Improved business continuity.

Tax-efficient asset transition.

Structured wealth preservation.

Long-term financial security.

Our Process

Step

Our Approach

Asset Review

Evaluate family assets, investments, and business interests.

Planning

Develop a customized succession and estate strategy.

Documentation

Coordinate preparation of wills and supporting records.

Implementation

Assist with asset structuring and succession planning.

Ongoing Advisory

Review and update the estate plan as circumstances evolve.

Preserving Wealth Across Generations

Our Succession & Estate Planning services are designed to help families protect their assets, ensure business continuity, and facilitate a smooth transfer of wealth to future generations. Through thoughtful planning and strategic tax advisory, we help clients build a lasting legacy while maintaining compliance with applicable tax laws.

services.title: Tax Audit under Section 44AB
services.intro: Section 44AB of the Income Tax Act mandates tax audits for specified businesses and professionals whose turnover or gross receipts exceed the prescribed limits. The objective of the audit is to verify the accuracy of books of accounts, ensure proper computation of taxable income, and confirm compliance with various provisions of the Income Tax Act. Timely completion of the audit helps businesses avoid penalties, strengthens financial transparency, and reduces the likelihood of future tax disputes.
services.introHero: Section 44AB of the Income Tax Act mandates tax audits for specified businesses and professionals whose turnover or gross receipts exceed the prescribed limits. Timely completion of the audit helps businesses avoid penalties, strengthens financial transparency, and reduces the likelihood of future tax disputes.
services.introRest: At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide end-to-end Tax Audit services under Section 44AB for businesses across various industries. Our professionals conduct detailed examinations of financial records, evaluate statutory compliance, and prepare audit reports in accordance with applicable tax laws.
services.body:
Our Tax Audit Services for Businesses

Applicability Assessment & Turnover Threshold Evaluation

The first step in every tax audit is determining whether the audit provisions apply to the business based on turnover, gross receipts, cash transactions, and other prescribed conditions.

Our assessment includes:

  1. Evaluation of turnover and gross receipts.
  2. Review of prescribed audit thresholds.
  3. Analysis of cash receipt and payment ratios.
  4. Applicability under presumptive taxation provisions, where relevant.

Comprehensive Examination of Books of Accounts

A detailed review of financial records helps ensure that the books of accounts accurately reflect the business's financial position.

We examine:

  1. Sales and purchase registers.
  2. Ledger accounts and journal entries.
  3. Trial balance and financial statements.
  4. Revenue recognition practices.
  5. Classification of capital and revenue expenditure.
  6. Inventory and stock valuation records.

Verification of Statutory Compliance

We review statutory compliances to ensure consistency across various tax and regulatory filings.

Our review includes:

  1. TDS deductions and return filings.
  2. Reconciliation of Form 26AS and AIS.
  3. GST return reconciliation with financial statements.
  4. Advance tax and self-assessment tax payments.
  5. Verification of statutory dues such as PF, ESI, and other applicable compliances.

Identification of Disallowances & Reporting Adjustments

Our audit identifies transactions that may require reporting or adjustment under the Income Tax Act.

We review:

  1. Expenses liable for disallowance.
  2. Cash payments exceeding prescribed limits.
  3. Interest and related party transactions.
  4. Specified payments requiring disclosure.
  5. Other reporting adjustments under applicable tax provisions.

Review of Related Party Transactions & Specified Payments

Certain transactions require additional disclosures under the tax audit report.

We assist in reviewing:

  1. Related party transactions.
  2. Specified domestic transactions.
  3. Loans and advances.
  4. Transactions requiring reporting under Form 3CD.

Clause-by-Clause Reporting under Form 3CD

Form 3CD requires detailed reporting of various financial and tax-related particulars.

Ensuring Accurate and Compliant Tax Audits

A properly conducted tax audit helps businesses strengthen compliance, improve financial reporting, and reduce potential tax risks. Our Section 44AB Tax Audit services provide a structured and comprehensive approach to audit and reporting, enabling businesses to meet their statutory obligations with confidence while maintaining transparency and regulatory compliance.

Tax Audit Services for Professionals

Professionals such as doctors, lawyers, architects, engineers, consultants, chartered accountants, freelancers, and other independent practitioners are required to comply with the tax audit provisions under Section 44AB when their gross professional receipts exceed the prescribed limits or when they become liable for audit under the presumptive taxation provisions. At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide comprehensive tax audit services for professionals, helping them maintain accurate financial records, comply with statutory requirements, and minimize the risk of scrutiny and penalties.

Reliable Tax Audit Support for Professionals

Timely completion of the audit helps businesses avoid penalties, strengthens financial transparency, and reduces the likelihood of future tax disputes.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide end-to-end Tax Audit services under Section 44AB for businesses across various industries. Our professionals conduct detailed examinations of financial records, evaluate statutory compliance, and prepare audit reports in accordance with applicable tax laws.

services.title: Audit under Presumptive Taxation

The presumptive taxation schemes under Sections 44AD, 44ADA, and 44AE simplify tax compliance for eligible taxpayers by allowing income to be declared on a presumptive basis. However, in certain situations, a tax audit becomes mandatory, such as when the taxpayer declares income below the prescribed limits or opts out of the presumptive taxation scheme while meeting the specified conditions. Understanding these provisions is essential to avoid penalties and ensure timely compliance.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we assist businesses and professionals in determining audit applicability under the presumptive taxation provisions and provide complete support for audit compliance where required.

Our Presumptive Taxation Audit Services

Applicability & Threshold Evaluation

We evaluate whether the taxpayer is required to undergo a tax audit under the applicable presumptive taxation provisions.

Our assessment includes:

Review of turnover and gross receipts.

Evaluation of declared income.

Applicability under Sections 44AD, 44ADA, and 44AE.

Audit threshold analysis.

Comparative Tax Regime Analysis

Selecting the appropriate taxation method can have a significant impact on tax liability and compliance requirements.

We assist with:

Comparison of presumptive and regular taxation.

Tax liability analysis.

Compliance evaluation.

Recommendation of the most suitable option.

Preparation of Books & Financial Statements

Where a tax audit becomes applicable, proper books of accounts and financial statements must be prepared.

Our services include:

Preparation of books of accounts.

Financial statement compilation.

Supporting documentation.

Audit readiness.

Timely Filing of Audit Report

We prepare and file the prescribed audit reports within the statutory due dates.

Our assistance includes:

Preparation of audit reports.

Compliance review.

Electronic filing.

Timely submission.

We advise taxpayers on minimizing the risk of penalties arising from non-compliance with the presumptive taxation provisions.

Our advisory includes:

Compliance planning.

Penalty risk assessment.

Corrective recommendations.

Future tax planning.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide Funding Compliance services to support startups throughout the fundraising journey by assisting with investor documentation, statutory filings, and regulatory compliance.

Our Funding Compliance Services Include

Investor Documentation

We assist in preparing and reviewing documentation required for investment transactions.

Our services include:

Investment agreements.

Share subscription documentation.

Corporate resolutions.

Due diligence documentation.

Regulatory Compliance

Investor Reporting Support

Post-Funding Compliance

We guide startups through post-investment corporate compliances, statutory updates, and regulatory reporting obligations.

Smooth fundraising process.

Complete investor documentation.

Drafting Support

We assist in preparing financial and statutory sections of the Draft Red Herring Prospectus.

Document Review

We review disclosures for accuracy, consistency, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

Financial Disclosure Support

Regulatory Coordination

We work alongside legal advisors, merchant bankers, and other professionals to facilitate timely completion of the prospectus.

Accurate regulatory disclosures.

Improved document quality.

Better investor transparency.

services.plainBody:
Cross-border income can potentially be taxed in both the source country and the taxpayer's country of residence. Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements (DTAAs) provide mechanisms for reducing or eliminating double taxation through treaty benefits, exemptions, reduced withholding rates, and foreign tax credits, subject to applicable conditions.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide DTAA planning services to help clients understand treaty provisions and structure cross-border transactions appropriately.

Our DTAA Planning Services Include

Treaty Applicability Assessment

We evaluate relevant tax treaties and determine their potential application to cross-border income and transactions.

Withholding Tax Advisory

We assess treaty-based withholding tax rates for dividends, interest, royalties, fees, and other international payments.

Foreign Tax Credit Planning

We assist clients in evaluating foreign tax credits available for taxes paid in overseas jurisdictions.

Treaty Documentation

We provide guidance on residency certificates, treaty declarations, and other documentation required to support treaty benefits.

Cross-Border Transaction Planning

We evaluate the tax treaty implications of international investments, business operations, and payments between related or unrelated parties.

Benefits

Reduced risk of double taxation.

Better understanding of treaty benefits.

Appropriate withholding tax planning.

Improved foreign tax credit utilization.

Stronger cross-border tax compliance.

Our Process

Stage

Our Approach

Transaction Review

Understand the nature and source of cross-border income.

Treaty Analysis

Identify relevant DTAA provisions.

Tax Assessment

Evaluate domestic and treaty-based tax implications.

Documentation

Identify required treaty support documents.

Compliance

Assist with implementation and reporting.

Optimizing Treaty-Based Tax Relief

Our DTAA Planning services help businesses and individuals navigate international tax treaties and manage cross-border taxation through compliant treaty planning and appropriate documentation.

In the UAE, businesses may be required to register for VAT based on applicable thresholds and must meet ongoing return filing and payment obligations. The UAE Federal Tax Authority currently states a mandatory VAT registration threshold of AED 375,000 and a voluntary registration threshold of AED 187,500 for eligible UAE-resident businesses. (FTA UAE)

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide VAT advisory and compliance support covering registration, return preparation, transaction reviews, and ongoing indirect tax obligations.

Our VAT Services Include

VAT Registration

We assess VAT registration requirements and assist eligible businesses with registration and Tax Registration Number (TRN) applications.

VAT Return Preparation & Filing

We prepare and assist with periodic VAT return filing and payment compliance within applicable deadlines. The UAE FTA states that VAT returns and related payments are generally due within 28 days from the end of the applicable tax period. (FTA UAE)

Input Tax Review

We review eligible input tax claims and supporting documentation to help businesses maintain accurate VAT records.

Transaction & Taxability Review

We assess taxable, zero-rated, exempt, and out-of-scope transactions and relevant cross-border supplies.

VAT Reconciliation

We reconcile accounting records, sales, purchases, VAT returns, and supporting documentation to identify discrepancies.

GCC Indirect Tax Advisory

For businesses operating across GCC markets, we provide jurisdiction-specific advisory and coordinate VAT compliance requirements applicable to the relevant country.

Benefits

Accurate VAT registration.

Timely return filing.

Better input tax management.

Reduced VAT compliance risks.

Improved transaction-level tax controls.

Professional GCC indirect tax support.

Our Process

Stage

Our Approach

Tax Assessment

Determine VAT applicability and registration requirements.

Registration

Assist with VAT registration and documentation.

Transaction Review

Analyze sales, purchases, and cross-border transactions.

Reconciliation

Reconcile accounting records with VAT data.

Filing

Prepare and submit periodic VAT returns.

Compliance Review

Monitor ongoing VAT obligations and regulatory changes.

Managing UAE & GCC VAT Compliance

Our VAT Registration, Compliance & Filing services help businesses manage indirect tax obligations through accurate registration, reconciliation, reporting, and ongoing advisory support.

services.plainBody:
International expansion involves decisions around market entry, entity formation, ownership, financing, taxation, repatriation, intellectual property, and operational substance. A poorly structured expansion can create unnecessary tax exposure, regulatory complexity, and operational costs.

At Ritesh Arora & Associates, we provide strategic financial and tax advisory to help businesses evaluate international expansion opportunities and develop commercially sustainable global structures.

Our Global Expansion Services Include

Market Entry Structure Assessment

We evaluate potential structures such as subsidiaries, branches, representative offices, holding companies, and other appropriate arrangements.

Jurisdiction Selection

We compare potential jurisdictions based on taxation, regulatory environment, operational requirements, investor access, and business objectives.

International Tax Structuring

We assess corporate tax, withholding tax, transfer pricing, treaty, permanent establishment, CFC, and other relevant international tax considerations.

Funding & Repatriation Planning

We evaluate how overseas operations can be funded and how profits or investment proceeds may be distributed or repatriated.

Group Structure Planning

We help businesses evaluate ownership chains, holding structures, intercompany arrangements, and reporting requirements.

Expansion Financial Modelling

We develop financial models to assess projected revenues, costs, capital requirements, cash flows, profitability, and potential returns from international expansion.

Benefits

Better international market-entry decisions.

Purpose-driven global structures.

Improved tax and regulatory planning.

Clearer funding requirements.

Better control over cross-border cash flows.

Scalable international operating models.

Our Process

Stage

Our Approach

Expansion Assessment

Understand business objectives and target markets.

Jurisdiction Analysis

Compare potential jurisdictions and entity structures.

Tax & Regulatory Review

Assess relevant international tax and compliance considerations.

Financial Modelling

Evaluate investment requirements and projected returns.

Structure Design

Develop an appropriate global operating and ownership framework.

Implementation Support

Assist with execution and ongoing financial oversight.

Enabling Sustainable Global Expansion

Our Global Expansion Planning & Tax-Efficient Structuring services help businesses enter international markets with a clear understanding of financial, tax, regulatory, and operational implications—creating structures designed to support long-term global growth.
